notes: Success rate and averages are computed by DWR from raw survey answers, not from the projected hunters/harvest estimates (stated on the LE/OIAL reports), so success != harvest/hunters.
Missing fields mean DWR printed nothing (no survey), never zero.
2020-2021 LE/OIAL reports have no weapon column and split bison harvest into male/female.
General elk: harvest columns sum exactly to the statewide totals in 2024; 2020-2023 within 0.5% (some rows are repeated per subunit).
2025 is preliminary (DWR file dated March 2026); it covers every species and hunt type, including CWMU and antlerless.
